name: dsh-cursor-theme
description: Per-state mouse cursor theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). 18 original preset themes covering 14 UI states, ZIP image pack import/export, hotspot/size editing, and one-click system-level cursor apply on Windows (registry + SPI_SETCURSORS) with an experimental macOS overlay. 为 DSH 自定义鼠标各种状态的图案，覆盖 14 种 UI 状态。
